specifications.title: Requirements-to-prompt trust-boundary map
specifications.scenario: A synthetic Python avatar endpoint is described in requirements and a model-generated draft is supplied as review input.
specifications.learnerDeliverable: Trust-boundary map, bounded prompt, generated-code assumptions, source-validation-sink trace, and human acceptance decision.
specifications.positiveNegativeFalsePositive: Positive: identify the server boundary; negative: treat browser input or model output as authority; false positive: a constant server-owned value is not an untrusted source.
specifications.futureEvidence: review artifact plus reviewer decision; not implemented here

specifications.title: Validation and interpreter-boundary review
specifications.scenario: A synthetic Python handler combines a free-form filter, SQL string building, subprocess invocation, and eval-based configuration.
specifications.learnerDeliverable: Allowlist grammar, parameterized query design, fixed subprocess argument map, eval/exec replacement, and regression test plan.
specifications.positiveNegativeFalsePositive: Positive: reject an unapproved grammar or executable; negative: accept shell syntax as data; false positive: a fixed enum mapped to a constant SQL identifier is not raw identifier injection under the stated mapping.
specifications.futureEvidence: review diff and test table; no executable harness exists

specifications.title: Data access and deserialization boundary review
specifications.scenario: A synthetic import endpoint accepts JSON/YAML and a legacy artifact path, then writes records through a Python data-access layer.
specifications.learnerDeliverable: Parser trust decision, schema/size policy, parameter binding review, and integrity assumptions for any application-owned fixture.
specifications.positiveNegativeFalsePositive: Positive: reject pickle or unsafe YAML from request input; negative: treat a parser exception as the only control; false positive: an integrity-protected test artifact is distinct from a user upload.
specifications.futureEvidence: parser decision record and fixture plan; no runtime DB access

specifications.title: Upload, path, and outbound-request review
specifications.scenario: A synthetic document service stores uploads and fetches a user-requested preview URL.
specifications.learnerDeliverable: Generated storage-name design, canonical containment rules, upload limits, SSRF URL/redirect policy, and false-positive rationale.
specifications.positiveNegativeFalsePositive: Positive: deny an outside path or disallowed destination; negative: trust filename or https alone; false positive: a fixed reviewed service endpoint has no user-controlled URL component under documented assumptions.
specifications.futureEvidence: path and URL edge-case matrix; no network or filesystem execution

specifications.title: Web context, CSRF, and safe-failure review
specifications.scenario: A synthetic Flask-style service renders a comment, changes state through a browser request, and emits errors and logs.
specifications.learnerDeliverable: Sink/control matrix, CSRF threat model, safe error contract, redaction policy, and autoescaping false-positive explanation.
specifications.positiveNegativeFalsePositive: Positive: identify raw HTML output or missing CSRF protection; negative: use HTML encoding in every context; false positive: verified escaped text rendering remains safe only for that sink.
specifications.futureEvidence: context matrix and reviewer rationale; no web harness exists

specifications.title: Identity and object authorization matrix
specifications.scenario: A synthetic document API supports owner, member, unrelated user, administrator, and unauthenticated requests.
specifications.learnerDeliverable: Subject-object-action matrix, server-side policy pseudocode, BOLA/IDOR tests, and session lifecycle checklist.
specifications.positiveNegativeFalsePositive: Positive: deny cross-user object substitution; negative: rely on client role or login alone; false positive: an explicitly server-authorized administrative action is not BOLA merely because it accesses another owner.
specifications.futureEvidence: authorization matrix and test plan; no runtime authorization write

specifications.title: Secrets and dependency response review
specifications.scenario: A synthetic Python service has a secret-like constant, an exception trace, a transitive dependency advisory, and a model-suggested package.
specifications.learnerDeliverable: Secret data-flow inventory, redaction policy, dependency triage note, provenance/owner questions, and compensating controls.
specifications.positiveNegativeFalsePositive: Positive: remove a real secret from source and logs; negative: treat a scanner result as a verdict; false positive: a clearly non-secret documentation placeholder is not credential exposure when no credential path exists.
specifications.futureEvidence: decision record; no dependency or environment change

specifications.title: Secure Python Vibe-Coding capstone
specifications.scenario: Learners take a bounded feature requirement through prompt, generated Python, triad review, attack/test design, AI repair, and human re-verification.
specifications.learnerDeliverable: Requirement, prompt, generated revision, findings, tests, repair diff, human decision, residual risk, and evidence gaps.
specifications.positiveNegativeFalsePositive: Positive: produce a secure application decision supported by tests; negative: accept model output as authority; false positive: document a safe fixture and its assumptions rather than suppressing it by pattern.
specifications.futureEvidence: capstone review packet; no executable lab or deployment is claimed
